description:
We are seeking a Risk and Compliance Paralegal to join our Legal Department’s Asia team. This role supports the firm’s Business Acceptance and Asia Legal functions across conflicts, client due diligence, anti-money laundering, sanctions, reputational risk and related compliance processes.

Key responsibilities

- Support business acceptance processes relating to conflicts, client due diligence, AML, sanctions and other risk matters.
- Maintain accurate client and matter records, assist with data remediation and support routine Legal Department enquiries.
- Conduct corporate, regulatory, sanctions, adverse media and reputational risk research, preparing clear summaries for review.
- Help maintain Business Acceptance systems, knowledge resources and guidance materials, including Intapp and related platforms.
- Contribute to regional and global process improvement, technology, automation and AI-enabled initiatives.

About you

- Undergraduate degree, preferably in law, business, compliance, risk management or a related discipline.
- Relevant experience in a legal, compliance, regulatory, risk management or professional services environment.
- Strong research, analytical and organisational skills, with excellent attention to detail and sound judgement.
- Confident using technology and databases, with an interest in data quality, process improvement and responsible use of AI.
- Clear and professional communicator who can work independently and collaborate effectively across an international team.
- Experience with conflicts, client due diligence, sanctions research or systems such as Intapp, World-Check, Orbis, Capital IQ or SharePoint would be an advantage. Chinese-language research capability would also be beneficial.

This is an excellent opportunity to build broad experience across business acceptance, compliance operations, risk intelligence and legal technology while working closely with colleagues across Asia and the global Legal Department.

description:
About the Company
Our client is an international investor in utility-scale renewable energy projects, with a growing portfolio across multiple regions including Asia Pacific, Europe, and the Americas. The business partners with project developers at an early phase and supports assets through to construction readiness and eventual divestment.
Responsibilities

- Review standard agreements such as NDAs and service contracts against internal precedents, flagging any deviations for senior legal review

- Keep contract databases and logs up to date, and support contract execution, approval, and archiving processes

- Manage corporate legal records, organise board and governance meetings, prepare related materials, and follow up on outstanding items

- Handle day-to-day legal administration, including document distribution, payment and expense processing, and coordination with other departments

- Contribute to the development of precedents and templates (NDAs, term sheets, investment documentation, checklists) and legal workflows used by the deal team

Requirements

- Eligible to work in Hong Kong without sponsorship

- Approximately 1-2 years of experience in an in-house legal, paralegal, or legal administrative capacity

- Excellent command of written and spoken English, with professional fluency in Chinese (essential)

- Foundational understanding of contracts, meticulous attention to detail, a strong sense of confidentiality, and proficiency in MS Office and document management platforms

Additional Information

- Involves an initial placement of around three months in Mainland China to work alongside the group legal team, followed by regular ongoing collaboration

- Occasional travel within Mainland China and to international project locations
